dedupeResult: The complete active pull-request repository search was checked separately for KZSU, WCBN and KDVS before creation and returned no existing route records. Canonical domains, normalized station names, public Music Director contacts, physical addresses, portal identifiers and delivery modes were compared. KZSU is stored once for its first-party portal and physical alternatives; WCBN and KDVS are each stored once as physical-only opportunities.
emailVerificationLevel: KZSU's music@kzsu.stanford.edu was confirmed as a plaintext first-party Music Director business contact, while the dedicated send-music portal and postal addresses remain the authoritative submission routes. WCBN exposes its Music Directors email through a protected or redacted first-party link in passive extraction; it was not decoded or guessed. KDVS's musicdept@kdvs.org was confirmed as a plaintext Music Department business contact, but the adjacent instruction explicitly requires all new music to be submitted physically, so it is not classified as a digital submission inbox. No SMTP, MX, catch-all or mailbox-level deliverability probe was performed.
safety: No email, message, form or submission was sent; no track, album, CD, vinyl, file, streaming link, metadata, biography, artwork, rights declaration or consent was supplied; no cookie or secure portal session was accepted; no physical package, postage purchase or shipment was prepared; no protected email address was decoded; no CAPTCHA, anti-bot, human-verification or platform control was handled or bypassed; no payment workflow was started; no contact was guessed; and no SMTP/MX/deliverability probing was performed.
items: KZSU Stanford Music Submission Portal and Physical Mail
